chunks: Was he the one of all of us to have been given the exposition? He is surely an impudent liar.

key_terms.الذِّكْرُ: The Reminder, referring to the Quran or divine revelation

ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say about Prophet Muhammad receiving the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Qamar, the Meccan disbelievers pose a rhetorical challenge to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), questioning why the Quran was revealed to him alone among their tribe, thereby highlighting the exclusivity of his prophetic mission. They dismiss the revelation as a fabrication, labeling him a 'lying, arrogant' (kadhdhab ashir) figure, a critique that Shia exegesis often links to their rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt's spiritual authority. This verse underscores the early opposition faced by the Prophet and serves as a precursor to the broader theme of divine selection amidst human skepticism.
